visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a cream-colored sweater stands in a retail aisle filled with hygiene products. He holds a black package of Sofy pads, gesturing toward it while speaking. Bright fluorescent lighting illuminates the colorful blue and green shelves. (2) The scene shifts to a checkout counter where the man stands before a cashier. Background shelves display makeup products from brands like KATE and MAYBELLINE. Large purple and blue promotional banners are visible in the background. (3) The man looks at the cashier with a confident, smug facial expression as he places a single item on the counter. Red and white variety show-style text overlays appear around his head. (4) The man's expression shifts to extreme shock, with his eyes widened and mouth agape as he leans slightly over the counter. He continues to hold a smartphone in his right hand. (5) The video frame transitions to monochrome (grayscale). The man walks away from the counter toward the left, looking disappointed and clutching the package of pads. 'Challenge Failed' text in white block letters appears centered on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced male narration begins immediately over an upbeat electronic dance music track with a prominent, synthesized bassline and a steady 4/4 drum beat. The voice is energetic and enunciated. (2) A sharp electronic 'beep' sound effect plays as the man interacts with a female cashier; the female voice is polite and higher in pitch with standard conversational projection. (3) A synthesized 'whoosh' and a 'ding' sound effect play simultaneously with the appearance of comedic text on screen. The male speaker's pitch rises dramatically to express pride. (4) A sudden musical shift occurs as the male voice gasps in shock; the background music maintains its tempo but introduces a high-pitched 'wow' meme sound effect. (5) The upbeat BGM cuts out abruptly, replaced by a stereotypical orchestral 'fail' stinger featuring a descending trombone slide and minor-key brass hits. The male speaker's voice drops in volume and pitch, ending in a low, disappointed mumble.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Challenge Execution -> Humorous Twist -> Failure Outcome.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a comedic skit featuring influencer Joeman performing a '100 Yuan Rich Challenge' at POYA. The intent is to show humor by having him deliberately refuse a 'Buy 1 Get 1 Free' deal on Sofy sanitary pads to appear wealthy, only to be jokingly embarrassed when the cashier reveals that many people do the same, subverting his attempt at a unique 'rich' flex.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent placement and handling of Sofy products, filming inside a POYA retail location, and mentions of specific brand deals.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-arousal vocal delivery and fast-paced editing typical of social media comedy trends to maintain viewer engagement during a brand promotion.
